stories.headline: Colorado Springs narcotics unit dismantles trafficking group after five-month probe, seizing 188 pounds of meth and 37,000 fentanyl pills
stories.summary: Four search warrants across El Paso County also turned up cash and three firearms.

stories.headline: Fresno man charged after allegedly carrying 4 kilograms of fentanyl into a restaurant to sell it
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors say the 39-year-old was arrested at the restaurant on Wednesday, and a further 400 grams of fentanyl plus an AR-style rifle with a 70-plus-round drum magazine…
